translation.name: Wycliffe's Bible with Modern Spelling
translation.englishName: English: Wycliffe's Bible Modern Spelling (with Deuterocanon)

content: To the victory, [the psalm]of David, to have mind. God, behold thou into mine help; Lord, haste thou to help me
Be they shamed, and ashamed; that seek my life. Be they turned aback; and shame they, that will or desire evils to me.
Be they turned away anon, and shame they; that say to me, Well! well!
All men that seek thee, make fully joy [or full out joy they], and be glad in thee; and they that love thine health, say ever[more], The Lord be magnified.
Forsooth I am a needy man, and poor; God help thou me. Thou art mine helper and my deliverer; Lord, tarry thou not.
